versions.localizedDescription: First public Nanashi release. Includes the latest NOOP source integration, preserved Nanashi personalization, and a dedicated update channel. Keep the widget and the same SideStore account when updating an existing installation. See the GitHub release for changes and verification.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Nanashi connects directly to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery, and sensor data locally on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Nanashi reads your own Apple Health data on-device to compute recovery, strain, and sleep. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Nanashi writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Nanashi records your route during an outdoor workout to show distance, pace, and a map, and keeps recording while the screen is off. The route stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Nanashi uses the microphone to let you ask the coach a question by voice. The audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your iPhone.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Nanashi reads your iPhone's step count for a walking or running workout to show steps in the activity summary. It stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Nanashi transcribes your question on-device so you can ask the coach out loud instead of typing. Audio never leaves your iPhone.
